# Monthaven Home Buyers

> A local cash home buyer serving Gaston, Cleveland, and Lincoln counties in North
> Carolina. We buy houses directly, as-is, with our own funds. We are not real estate
> agents and we are not a lead broker.

## What we do
- Buy single-family houses, townhomes, small multifamily, manufactured homes on owned
  land, and vacant lots, in any condition.
- Provide a written cash offer within 24 hours of walking the property.
- Close in 7 to 21 days at a North Carolina closing attorney, on the seller's chosen date.
- Pay the seller's standard closing costs. No commission and no fees to the seller.
- Buy tenant-occupied, vacant, damaged, inherited, and pre-foreclosure properties.

## What we do not do
- We do not pay full retail market value. A cash offer is below retail; that is the
  trade-off for speed, certainty, and requiring no repairs.
- We do not list properties or act as agents or brokers.
- We do not sell or share seller contact information with other buyers or lead brokers.
- We do not renegotiate an accepted offer after the walkthrough. There is no inspection
  contingency.

## When a seller should NOT use us
- The house is in good condition and the seller has two to three months: listing with an
  agent will usually net more.
- The seller is only slightly behind on payments and could catch up via a repayment plan
  or loan modification.
- The seller owes more than the house is worth: a short sale with lender approval may be
  the only route.

## Service area
Gaston County NC: Gastonia, Belmont, Mount Holly, Bessemer City, Cherryville, Dallas, Stanley
Cleveland County NC: Shelby, Kings Mountain
Lincoln County NC: Lincolnton
